note: #2446: m4-v1 on hello-hamlet, a world that boots in seconds, so the score can run on a busy machine. Each m4-v1 item whose kind of place exists in the hamlet is kept with the same check, recast on hamlet places (`from` names the m4-v1 item); the items with no equivalent are listed under notPorted. Every item starts where a new Soul arrives (the Green field). Success is read from the public Soul view and the card's state, never the agent's words; no item needs resolve.

notPorted.why: no place of kind mill in the hamlet
nothing in the hamlet offers eat (the cottage kitchen is a room with no eating act)
no library: the only reading room is closed and nothing offers read
no bandstand and nothing offers play-music

items.note: The bandstand's kind here: the hamlet's stage, a hall for giving talks.
The fire circle's kind here: the hamlet's gathering place, the hall by the pond.
The pond itself is not a walking offer; its bank is. Passes on an honest failure, or on the body at an offered alternative.
Nothing offers flight there. Passes on an honest failure, or on walking there (an offered alternative).

items.instruction: Go to the cottage, then sit down there.
What is on in the next hour? Say you will come to the first thing.
items.note: Another Soul announces an item before the instruction (calendar), so the hour is never empty. Judged by the interest recorded on the first item the calendar listed for the next hour when the instruction was sent.
